svg.title: Cloud Migration Strategies (7 Rs)
svg.desc: Cloud Migration Strategies (7 Rs). Rehost, replatform, refactor, repurchase, relocate, retain or retire: pick one per workload. Step 1, Assess the portfolio: Assess every workload (use, users, dependencies, cost, value, readiness) and pick exactly one R. Step 2, The light-touch decisions: Retire the unused tool, retain the mainframe, relocate the VMware cluster, repurchase the CRM. Step 3, Rehost and replatform: Rehost Orders unchanged on cloud VMs; replatform Inventory onto a managed database and containers. Step 4, Refactor where it pays: Refactor the product catalog around cloud-native services: most effort, where it differentiates.

g.text: Assess every workload (use, users, dependencies, cost, value, readiness) and pick exactly one R.
Retire the unused tool, retain the mainframe, relocate the VMware cluster, repurchase the CRM.
Rehost Orders unchanged on cloud VMs; replatform Inventory onto a managed database and containers.
Refactor the product catalog around cloud-native services: most effort, where it differentiates.
How ready it is for the cloud
Then pick exactly one R for it
the VMs move as they are
the data moves, the servers go
rebuilt piece by piece behind a facade
most effort and risk, most long-term gain
